title: Distance After Toggling One Coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, let $w:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a Boolean string, and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. The relative Hamming distance between $w$ and the string obtained by toggling its $i$th coordinate is $1/n$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
$i$ is a coordinate in the string
